summary: This code imports a custom Docusaurus plugin for handling tag routes and then registers it in the site configuration by adding it to the plugins array with an empty options object. Docusaurus will load and execute this plugin when the site builds.

explanations.7: The plugin is added as a two-element array where the first element is the plugin itself and the second element is an empty object — that empty object would be where you pass configuration options to the plugin if it needed any.
